findings.one_line: The key implication from complete CTFIDU+ nonfailure to forall alpha exists a successful source tuple (and its converse) is not derivable from the declared dependencies: CTFIDU+ is only an opaque algorithm symbol/acceptance call, with no theorem specifying its branch-search decomposition; the proof assumes exactly the unresolved crux.

A cover of local Succ_alpha incidences is asserted to make the complete CTFIDU+ run nonfailing, but local IDENTIFY+ transcripts do not, from the supplied definitions, establish the global run's acceptance; this repeats the unproved full-acceptance equivalence rather than reproducing it.

The claimed iff with the ordinary single-world procedure cannot be reproduced from the listed definitions and the cited IDENTIFY+ recursion: neither procedure's full recursion/preprocessing semantics is supplied, and the assertion that their closures are identical is assumed rather than derived.

The reverse optimum inequality relies on the unproved single-world operational specialization to turn arbitrary accepted physical READ-conditioned sources into ordinary full-kernel identification, so the claimed equality is not yet discharged.
The supplied attested excerpt establishes strict decrease/exit behavior only; it does not attest the claimed least-H rule, marginal/FAIL branches, or district recursion used by the obstruction proof.

The supplied source-of-record attests only a polynomial MWHS reduction, not the claimed same-cost finite interventions or the original-versus-infinite-cost auxiliary construction used in the hardness transfer.
